item.title: Hong Kong Clinics Introduce Palm Verification for Contactless Check-In
item.description: Tencent and Bupa Hong Kong have introduced a palm verification check-in service across 20 Bupa clinics, including flagship centres in Central, Tsim Sha Tsui, and Admiralty, offering customers a contactless check-in option.
